I have the same thought. If it was part of the plan to possibly sleep at the Hilton anyway why would you leave? Especially with Brittany upset/worried and your friend (who you saw last) still missing ... this really bothers me because who would just leave with their friend missing? 

“Going out drinking 101”: have a charged phone and don’t leave your friends... either something fishy is going on or this group was a little clueless and naive about going out drinking safely.

She is super detailed up until the Uber ride...That struck me as odd too. Doesn’t necessarily equal guilt, it could also suggest by this time of night they were all very drunk and timelines and details aren’t as clear.
